# AI Prompts

This directory contains reusable prompt templates for AI-assisted block development.

## Files

- **prompts.md** - Prompt template definitions and examples for block development

## Purpose

Prompt templates provide:

- Consistent AI interaction patterns for blocks
- Reusable block code generation templates
- Standardized block documentation formats
- Common block development task workflows

## Usage

Prompts are referenced by AI development tools to generate consistent, high-quality block code and documentation that follows WordPress block development standards.
